{{Infobox auto|title=Elegy of Arachnae|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Elegy of Arachnae''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Bane of Arthropods}} V. It is crafted from four spider eyes. Bane of Arthropods V is the highest enchantment level stored on any blessing.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/bane_of_arthopods.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Elegy of Arachnae" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Elegy of Arachnae is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Bane of Arthropods applies to weapons. It is exclusive with the other damage enchantments (Sharpness, Smite, Impaling, Density and Breach) and with [[Slaughter]].

== Trivia ==
* Arachne is the weaver of Greek myth whom Athena turned into a spider. The pack spells the name "Arachnae", and the recipe file is spelled <code>bane_of_arthopods</code>.
